title: Qu'est-ce qu'une galerie?
oneGoal: Students will understand the purpose and function of art galleries
decisionPoints: Do students understand gallery vs museum concepts?
What gallery experiences have they had?
How to make gallery concepts accessible and relevant?
progression: Foundation lesson - establishes gallery understanding and vocabulary
realWorldConnection: Visiting museums, art shows, looking at displays in libraries or community centers

title: Rôles dans une galerie
oneGoal: Students will identify different roles people play in gallery operations
decisionPoints: Can students understand different professional roles?
What roles interest them most?
How to connect roles to their own classroom gallery?
progression: Builds on Lesson 1 by exploring human aspects of gallery operations
realWorldConnection: Understanding different jobs people do, like teachers, doctors, store workers

title: Sélection d'œuvres
oneGoal: Students will learn to curate and select artworks for exhibition
decisionPoints: Are students making thoughtful selection choices?
What criteria are they developing for quality?
How to balance personal preference with curatorial thinking?
progression: Builds on Lesson 2 by engaging students in curatorial decision-making
realWorldConnection: Choosing photos for albums, selecting clothes to wear, picking favorite books

title: Présentation et affichage
oneGoal: Students will learn effective methods for displaying artwork
decisionPoints: Are students considering how display affects viewing?
What presentation methods work best for different art?
How to balance aesthetics with practical constraints?
progression: Builds on Lesson 3 by focusing on physical presentation of selected works
realWorldConnection: Arranging their bedroom, setting table for dinner, organizing school supplies

title: Étiquettes et information
oneGoal: Students will create informative labels and descriptions for artworks
decisionPoints: Can students write clear, helpful descriptions?
What information is most important for viewers?
How to balance French learning with clear communication?
progression: Builds on Lesson 4 by adding informational component to display
realWorldConnection: Reading labels in stores, signs at zoo, instructions for games

title: Parcours de visite
oneGoal: Students will design logical pathways for gallery visitors
decisionPoints: Are students thinking about visitor experience?
What sequence makes sense for their exhibition?
How to guide visitor attention and movement?
progression: Builds on Lesson 5 by considering overall visitor experience and flow
realWorldConnection: Following paths in parks, routes through stores, order of activities in their day

title: Vernissage et inauguration
oneGoal: Students will plan and execute a gallery opening event
decisionPoints: How formal should the opening be?
What roles will students play during the event?
How to make the event welcoming and informative?
progression: Builds on Lesson 6 by planning celebratory launch of gallery
realWorldConnection: Birthday parties, school concerts, family gatherings

title: Visite guidée
oneGoal: Students will conduct guided tours of their gallery
decisionPoints: Are students confident presenting to others?
What information should tours include?
How to adapt tours for different audiences?
progression: Builds on Lesson 7 by actively engaging with gallery visitors
realWorldConnection: Showing friends their room, explaining games to others, teaching family members new things

title: Critique et évaluation
oneGoal: Students will gather and respond to feedback about their gallery
decisionPoints: How do students receive constructive criticism?
What improvements are they willing to make?
How to use feedback for gallery enhancement?
progression: Builds on Lesson 8 by incorporating visitor feedback for improvement
realWorldConnection: Getting suggestions from friends, teacher feedback on work, family advice

title: Art français célèbre
oneGoal: Students will explore famous French artworks and artists
decisionPoints: What French art connects to student interests?
How to make historical art relevant and accessible?
What cultural connections can students make?
progression: Builds on Lesson 9 by connecting their gallery to broader French artistic heritage
realWorldConnection: Learning about their country's history, famous people from their area

title: Techniques françaises traditionnelles
oneGoal: Students will try traditional French artistic techniques
decisionPoints: What traditional techniques are accessible to students?
How to honor cultural traditions while making them relevant?
What connections to their own heritage can they make?
progression: Builds on Lesson 10 by experiencing French artistic traditions hands-on
realWorldConnection: Learning traditional recipes, games, or crafts from their own family

title: Galerie virtuelle
oneGoal: Students will create digital documentation of their gallery
decisionPoints: What technology tools are available and appropriate?
How to maintain gallery experience in digital format?
What elements translate well to virtual presentation?
progression: Builds on Lesson 11 by expanding gallery reach through digital documentation
realWorldConnection: Taking photos to share with family, video calls with distant relatives

title: Échange avec d'autres galeries
oneGoal: Students will connect with other classroom galleries or art spaces
decisionPoints: What other classes or schools might participate in exchange?
How to facilitate meaningful artistic exchange?
What can students learn from other gallery approaches?
progression: Builds on Lesson 12 by connecting their gallery to broader artistic community
realWorldConnection: Pen pals, visiting other classrooms, community connections

title: Évolution de la galerie
oneGoal: Students will plan how their gallery will change and grow over time
decisionPoints: How can the gallery continue beyond this unit?
What changes would improve the gallery experience?
How to maintain student ownership and investment?
progression: Builds on Lesson 13 by planning sustainable gallery development
realWorldConnection: How their room changes as they grow, family traditions that evolve

title: Célébration finale
oneGoal: Students will celebrate their gallery achievements and plan future artistic endeavors
decisionPoints: How to appropriately celebrate student achievement?
What gallery learning will continue beyond the unit?
How to maintain connection to French artistic culture?
progression: Culminates all learning by celebrating gallery success and planning continued growth
realWorldConnection: Graduation ceremonies, end-of-season celebrations, family milestones
